response.original_title: في انتظار الساعة الخامسة و العشرين
response.overview: An amateur docu-fiction set in Taffala, the slums of Sousse, Tunisia. While working, Tijani stumbles upon an old camera and with the help of the neighborhood photographer, sets out to direct a film capturing the daily life of Taffala.
response.title: Waiting for the 25th Hour
